value.rationale: The canonical trigonal map of a distinguished superspecial genus-four curve naturally leads to a new nonabelian S3 normal closure of genus 13. Its maximality is not a routine consequence of genus-four maximality, because the genus-five discriminant quotient contributes separately. Exact ramification and Frobenius fiber data supply a useful explicit maximal higher-genus cover.
